title: Sheaves of modules on the small etale site have enough injectives
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $R$ a commutative ring, and let $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of $R_T$-modules on the small etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$ has enough injectives: for every object $F$ there are an injective object $J$ of $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and a monomorphism $F\hookrightarrow J$ in $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$.

source.place: Injectives, Theorem 01DU (label theorem-sheaves-modules-injectives): the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules on a site has enough injectives; used in Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0A4C (label lemma-sandwich), proof, first paragraph ("Choose an injective map of sheaves $f^{-1}\mathcal I\to\mathcal J$ where $\mathcal J$ is an injective sheaf of $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$-modules")
